recipe.criteria: Standing right knee curl against a red resistance band secured to the low front rack. Left foot on step, fixed hands and torso, knee 180 to 80 degrees; four seconds each direction. Band length increases while its thickness decreases.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
